symptom: The authorized Supabase connector refused both production SQL read and apply_migration calls with permission denied after earlier successful access in the same execution line.
impact: New governed database migrations can be merged and verified in GitHub but must not be represented as production-active until the official Supabase migration route is authorized again and readback succeeds.
nextAction: Restore or re-authorize the official Supabase management permission, then apply exact merged migrations in order and perform production readback. Never substitute untracked direct DDL.
